{{Quote|It is no easy thing to hunt the lizardflies. They nest, most perfect of all strangers, in the cliffs above Outreachial. Many days travel. Very hard.|A bazaar seller to [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]]|<ref name="Star Wars Campaign Pack">''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''</ref>}}
'''Outreachial''' was a settlement on a [[Unidentified planet (Outreachial)|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Lizardfly|Lizardflies]] made their homes in the cliffs above.
